state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stages 9 and 10 are done, and Stage 11 is in progress.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv audit ci` exists (`tools/nv/cmd/audit.ts`, `auditCi`). It exits 1 and names three kinds of offender: 10 workflow steps that still run `python tools/lints.py` or `python tools/release.py`, 4 lines of `tools/git-hooks/pre-push`, and the two website sync scripts. That is the red Stage 11 check. It is an open item and not a regression.

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs Bun in every job whose tool has a `bun nv` port: `changes`, `database`, `migration-table`, `reference` and `docs`. The docs job also runs `bun nv check` and `bun nv render --check`, and it installs Python for `release.py --check` alone. Every replacement command passed locally before the change.

**`tools/git-hooks/pre-push` refuses every push today.** It runs `python tools/loop.py --owed`, `tools/loop.py` forwards to `bun nv loop`, and `bun nv loop` has no `--owed`, so `parseTurn` returns null and the hook exits 2. `--settle` is missing in the same way.

`tools/playbook.py`'s module doc still lists the `reviewed` kind. That file goes in Stage 12.
